events.title: Energy Enhancement Technology & Sound Journey
events.desc:
The EESystem uses quantum technology to generate scalar waves that recharge your body’s cells to an optimal energy level.


 When paired with the acoustic vibrations of live sound healing instruments, it creates a powerful compound effect that instantly shifts your nervous system out of stress mode. 


This dual approach accelerates cellular regeneration, deeply reduces inflammation, and clears away mental clutter. Ultimately, it bathes the body in a multi-dimensional field of healing frequencies for profound physical and mental reset.

To register: call Revitalife directly at (780) 975-0385 — or tap through to their page to book your spot.

events.title:
Restorative Yoga
& Living Soundscapes
events.desc:
Join Mel  Checknita & Marcus for a restorative yoga & healing sounds journey. Mel will lead you through a Restorative Yoga practice designed to relax and nourish the body and mind.

Explore healing and supportive poses that will benefit your nervous system, ease muscular tension and release physical stress. Restorative yoga is very relaxing and slow paced.  healing music.

Imagine a living, flowing tapestry of frequencies, rhythms, and sounds that soothe and regulate the nervous system, and promote the process of healing and emotional processing. The full frequency spectrum of deeply resonating sounds will help you to relax, and restore as you ground the body, clear the mind, and elevate the spirit. The perfect combination to let go, restore and renew this winter season.

Recommended Props: blocks, bolsters, blankets and straps are used so that you are supported in your pose comfortably.

All levels are welcome

events.title:
Yoga & Sound Bath
Japanese Gardens
events.desc:
Yoga + Soundbath in the Garden
Four people sitting on yoga mats doing a side bend in front of waterfall in Aga Khan Garden

Yoga in the Garden begins with a gentle and inclusive hour-long yoga practice led by instructor Melanie Maltais. You are encouraged to embrace the beauty of silence during the session, allowing for a deeper connection with breath and sensation. If any movements do not suit you, you are free to modify poses, rest, sit, or lie down at any time. All are welcome as they are.

Following a quick break, participants will settle in for a rejuvenating hour-long sound bath. Using instruments tuned to healing frequencies, the sound bath offers a full-body reset to relax the mind, body and spirit. The gentle yoga beforehand allows for the vibrations to resonate more deeply, enhancing the benefits of the sound experience.

Together, these experiences are designed to support nervous system regulation, inner stillness and deep relaxation.

Includes yoga, sound bath and admission to the Garden.

Clearing & Balancing:
Sound Journey through the Chakras
events.desc:
An immersive and melodic multi-instrumental sound journey that also features the human voice. With sound, we navigate the map of the 7 chakra centres.

As each energy centre (chakra) is touched in resonance, you're invited to meet your own felt sense: clearing what's stagnant and returning to balance, from the ground up.

Come as you are. Intimate home studio — room for 8.

events.title:
Held & Nurtured:
Divine Mother Journey
events.desc:
A soft, loving space to be held, nurtured, and carried home deep into yourself.

The human voice is the heart of this journey — a healing instrument at its most tender, woven into a tapestry of song with a looping pedal, carried over crystal singing bowls, deep sine tones, and a profound Grotto Sonora gong.

Come as you are. Intimate home studio — thick mats, sheepskins, blankets and tea all provided.
